fusions.name: Four on the Floor
fusions.desc: Drops on all four feet, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Clod From Afar
fusions.desc: A thrown blow of pond mud that deals 40 damage, up to 2 times that at its maximum reach of 14 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Saddled Toad
fusions.desc: A bonded giant toad fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds and slowing each by 15% for 2 seconds. You can ride it.
